def _sign_rsa(hash_algorithm_name: str, sig_base_str: str, rsa_private_key: str
    ):
    # Get the implementation of RSA-with-hash algorithm to use
    alg = _get_jwt_rsa_algorithm(hash_algorithm_name)

    # Prepare the private key
    key = _prepare_key_plus(alg, rsa_private_key)

    # Sign the signature base string
    # The signature base string only contains printable US-ASCII characters
    sig = alg.sign(sig_base_str.encode('ascii'), key)

    # Return base64-encoded signature without trailing newline
    return binascii.b2a_base64(sig)[:-1].decode('utf-8')
